name: candle
description: Portable field definitions mirroring backend scrapedProductSchema

llm.instruction: Return the product page URL unchanged.
Return the category slug (e.g. candle). Usually injected from site defaults, not extracted from page text.
Return the brand display name. Usually injected from site defaults, not extracted from page text.
Return a URL-safe slug for the brand. Usually derived from brand_name.
Extract the clean product title. Remove category prefixes, size suffixes, and navigation noise. Title-case appropriately.
Return a URL-safe slug derived from the product name.
Extract clean marketing copy in full sentences. Exclude dimensions, weight, burn time, packaging, safety warnings, navigation, prices, and SKUs.
Return a short phrase describing the overall scent character (e.g. from 'Olfactive Family: Woody Aromatic' extract 'Woody Aromatic'). Not the accord list or note list.
Extract the release year as a 4-digit integer, or null if not stated.
Return exactly one of: soy, paraffin, beeswax, coconut, palm, blend, other — or null if not stated. Use blend for unspecified wax mixtures.
Return the vessel/container material (glass, ceramic, tin, metal, concrete, porcelain, wood) or null if not stated.
Return true only if the product is explicitly marked discontinued or out of production. Otherwise false.
Extract numeric size value(s). For multiple variants (e.g. 200G 500G), return a JSON array of numbers.
Extract the size unit (g, oz, etc.) it should be one unit only, do not return multiple units
Extract size in grams as integer(s). Convert from oz if needed (1 oz ≈ 28.35g). Return a number or array aligned with size variants.
Extract price as integer minor units (pence/cents). Example: £71.00 -> 7100, $24.50 -> 2450. Return a number or array aligned with size variants.
Return ISO 4217 currency code(s). Example: £ -> GBP, $ -> USD, € -> EUR. Return a string or array aligned with size variants.
Extract burn time in whole hours (e.g. 'up to 50 hours' -> 50). Return a number or array aligned with size variants.
Extract SKU or product code if present. Return a string or array aligned with size variants.
Extract availability status (InStock, OutOfStock, PreOrder, etc.) or null.
Extract variant-specific URL if present, otherwise null.
A single fragrance note/ingredient name (e.g. 'Italian Lemon', 'Mint Leaves'). Do NOT include olfactive family lines or broad accords.
Derived from note_name slugs.

The pyramid stage this note belongs to: top, middle, base, general, or unknown. Map Top/Head->top, Heart/Middle->middle, Base/Dry-down->base. Use 'unknown' when the note is given without any stage grouping.
Extract broad fragrance accords/families as a JSON array (woody, citrus, floral, gourmand, amber, green, aromatic, etc.). Infer from copy when an explicit accord list exists.
Derived from accord_name slugs.
Images are assembled from scraped files, not LLM.

structuredScopes.instruction: Extract each fragrance note from the source text as its own object. The source may be a plain sentence or list of notes, OR it may group notes under pyramid headings (Top/Head, Heart/Middle, Base/Dry-down). When a grouping is present, set pyramid_stage for each note from its heading; when the notes are just listed in prose with no grouping, set pyramid_stage to 'unknown'. Never invent stages. Exclude olfactive-family lines and broad accords.
